label: Arrow up
intent: The arrow goes up. Light: it launches up along its shaft, accelerating, and fades before the edge; a fresh arrow slides in from behind, lands just past its rest pose and settles. Strong: it winds back first, launches farther with a speed trail that retracts behind it, and the fresh arrow lands with a bigger overshoot and settles in two beats. Shaft and head are one part so they fade as one.

trail.//: hidden at rest: a speed streak along the shaft's rest line, retracting toward the tip as the arrow leaves

arrow.//: v1 shaft + head; Solid is the union of v1's capsule and filled head
